sources.name: Original federal bill text versions
sources.coverage: Complete source versions; historical import verified

inclusion: Speeches from 1993-03-13 (the election that seated the longest-serving current federal MP), at least 200 characters, deduplicated across overlapping sources, procedural rows removed (division roll-calls, chair interjections, day indexes). External statements require an official source URL, a valid date, an open licence, at least 200 characters and a unique body. News articles are excluded from ingestion and retrieval; headline links are external only. Structured grant, election and roster records retain source provenance and snapshot dates; research notes are attributed summaries, not copies of full reports.

models.enrichment: Codex subscription workers; automatic provider summaries disabled

known_defects: openaustralia-derived texts: roughly a quarter contain missing-space concatenation artefacts ('toSenator'); verify wording against the official record before quoting.

Member biographical linkage is unreliable for 151 members (~35K speeches); Representation enrichment uses exact-name, jurisdiction and chamber agreement, not person ID alone; affiliations may be historical and roster service dates are not used.
AEC donation disclosure: amounts under the indexed threshold are not reported; donation totals are a floor, not a ceiling.
SA Hansard stops at November 2024: hansardsearch.parliament.sa.gov.au now sits behind a WAF that challenges every non-browser request, so the source cannot be fetched.

source_limitations: SA Hansard refresh blocked by source HTTP 403; stored coverage ends 2024-11-12.
Federal Hansard is current to 2026-09-17 with three source pages returning HTTP 403; NSW Parliament to 2026-09-17; Victoria to 2026-09-10; QLD to 2026-08-26.
Federal interests pages returned no usable records during this refresh. Existing disclosures were preserved.
New AEC source snapshots are retained for reconciliation. Amended federal donation rows have not replaced reviewed public data.
Ministerial diary and IPEA expense refreshes returned the same published rows as the previous verified snapshots.

enrichment.method: Exact unambiguous recorded names and structured source locations. Exact full-name identity decisions retain ABN provenance; unresolved candidates are unpublished.
enrichment.coverage_note: Collected source corpus; coverage differs from searchable records. Postcode overlaps are not precise locations.
